id-20260803-news-1.title: July 2026 Inflation Announced Today: Chili and Onion Prices Drop, But Does Purchasing Power Improve?

segments.src: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) menjadwalkan rilis data Indeks Harga Konsumen (IHK) untuk periode Juli 2026 pada hari ini, Senin, 3 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS) is scheduled to release the Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for the July 2026 period today, Monday, August 3, 2026.

segments.src: Menjelang pengumuman, sejumlah ekonom memperkirakan laju inflasi tahunan melandai ke kisaran **3,08 persen (year-on-year)**, terutama karena harga komoditas pangan bergejolak seperti cabai merah, cabai rawit, dan bawang merah bergerak turun seusai puncak panen di beberapa sentra produksi.
segments.tr: Ahead of the announcement, several economists estimate the annual inflation rate will flatten to around **3.08 percent (year-on-year)**, primarily because volatile food commodity prices such as red chili, bird's eye chili, and shallots are moving downward following the peak harvest in several production centers.

segments.src: Angka tersebut masih berupa **perkiraan konsensus**, bukan angka resmi.
segments.tr: This figure is still a **consensus estimate**, not an official figure.

segments.src: Data final hanya sah jika dikutip dari rilis BPS.
segments.tr: Final data is only valid if quoted from the BPS release.

segments.src: Namun terlepas dari berapa angka yang keluar nanti, ada satu pertanyaan yang jauh lebih penting bagi rumah tangga: kalau inflasi turun, apakah itu otomatis berarti isi dompet kita membaik?
segments.tr: However, regardless of what figure comes out later, there is one question that is far more important for households: if inflation drops, does it automatically mean our wallets are better off?
The answer is not that simple.

segments.src: Artikel ini membedah cara membaca rilis inflasi secara utuh, bukan hanya angka utamanya.
segments.tr: This article dissects how to read the inflation release in its entirety, not just the headline figure.

segments.src: ## Apa Sebenarnya yang Diumumkan BPS Setiap Awal Bulan?
segments.tr: ## What Exactly Does BPS Announce Every Beginning of the Month?

segments.src: Setiap awal bulan, BPS merilis perkembangan IHK yang mencakup beberapa angka sekaligus.
segments.tr: At the beginning of every month, BPS releases the CPI developments which cover several figures at once.

segments.src: Banyak orang hanya menangkap satu angka dari judul berita, padahal minimal ada empat yang perlu dilihat:
segments.tr: Many people only catch one figure from the news headline, while there are at least four that need to be seen:
| Indicator | Meaning | Why it is important |

segments.src: | Inflasi bulanan (m-to-m) | Perubahan harga Juli dibanding Juni | Menangkap tekanan harga paling baru |
segments.tr: | Monthly inflation (m-to-m) | Price change in July compared to June | Captures the most recent price pressures |

segments.src: | Inflasi tahunan (y-on-y) | Perubahan harga Juli 2026 dibanding Juli 2025 | Angka utama yang paling sering dikutip |
segments.tr: | Annual inflation (y-on-y) | Price change in July 2026 compared to July 2025 | The main figure most frequently quoted |

segments.src: | Inflasi tahun kalender (y-to-d) | Akumulasi sejak Januari 2026 | Menunjukkan beban harga sepanjang tahun berjalan |
segments.tr: | Calendar year inflation (y-to-d) | Accumulation since January 2026 | Shows the price burden throughout the current year |

segments.src: | Inflasi inti (core) | IHK tanpa pangan bergejolak dan harga diatur pemerintah | Cermin permintaan domestik yang sesungguhnya |
segments.tr: | Core inflation (core) | CPI without volatile food and government-regulated prices | A mirror of actual domestic demand |

segments.src: Selain itu, BPS juga memerinci sepuluh kelompok pengeluaran, andil masing-masing komoditas, serta sebaran inflasi antar kota.
segments.tr: Additionally, BPS also details ten expenditure groups, the contribution of each commodity, and the distribution of inflation between cities.

segments.src: Bagian rincian inilah yang biasanya paling informatif, tetapi paling jarang dibaca.
segments.tr: This detailed section is usually the most informative, but the least read.

segments.src: ## Kenapa Cabai dan Bawang Bisa Menekan Angka Inflasi Sebesar Itu?
segments.tr: ## Why Can Chili and Onions Press Down the Inflation Figure That Much?

segments.src: Cabai dan bawang merah memiliki bobot yang relatif kecil dalam keranjang IHK — jauh lebih kecil dibanding beras, sewa rumah, atau bensin.
segments.tr: Chili and shallots have a relatively small weight in the CPI basket — much smaller than rice, house rent, or gasoline.

segments.src: Namun keduanya punya karakter khas: **volatilitasnya ekstrem**.
segments.tr: However, both have a distinct character: **extreme volatility**.

segments.src: Harga cabai bisa naik puluhan persen dalam sebulan saat pasokan tersendat oleh hujan berlebih, lalu anjlok tajam ketika panen raya datang bersamaan di beberapa daerah.
segments.tr: Chili prices can rise by dozens of percent in a month when supply is disrupted by excessive rain, then plummet sharply when the grand harvest arrives simultaneously in several regions.

segments.src: Karena andil terhadap inflasi dihitung dari bobot dikalikan perubahan harga, lonjakan atau penurunan yang besar tetap bisa menggerakkan angka utama secara signifikan.
segments.tr: Because the contribution to inflation is calculated from the weight multiplied by the price change, a large surge or drop can still move the main figure significantly.

segments.src: Inilah alasan kelompok tersebut disebut **volatile food** atau pangan bergejolak.
segments.tr: This is why this group is called **volatile food**.

segments.src: Pergerakannya lebih ditentukan oleh cuaca, siklus tanam, dan rantai distribusi ketimbang oleh kekuatan daya beli masyarakat.
segments.tr: Its movement is determined more by weather, planting cycles, and distribution chains than by the strength of public purchasing power.

segments.src: Konsekuensinya sederhana namun sering terlewat: deflasi cabai bulan ini bukan bukti bahwa ekonomi rumah tangga menguat, dan bukan pula jaminan harga akan tetap murah pada kuartal berikutnya.
segments.tr: The consequence is simple but often overlooked: a deflation of chili this month is not evidence that household economies are strengthening, nor is it a guarantee that prices will remain cheap in the next quarter.

segments.src: ## Lima Alasan Inflasi Rendah Belum Tentu Berarti Daya Beli Membaik
segments.tr: ## Five Reasons Why Low Inflation Doesn't Necessarily Mean Improved Purchasing Power

segments.src: ### 1. Inflasi mengukur laju, bukan tingkat harga
segments.tr: ### 1. Inflation measures the rate, not the price level
This is the most common misunderstanding.

segments.src: Inflasi 3 persen bukan berarti harga turun 3 persen — artinya harga masih **naik**, hanya saja lebih pelan.
segments.tr: 3 percent inflation does not mean prices dropped 3 percent — it means prices are still **rising**, just more slowly.
This increase is also cumulative.

segments.src: Harga yang naik beberapa persen setiap tahun selama beberapa tahun berturut-turut membuat level harga hari ini tetap jauh di atas beberapa tahun lalu, meski laju kenaikannya melambat.
segments.tr: Prices that rise a few percent every year for several consecutive years keep today's price level far above several years ago, even if the rate of increase slows down.

segments.src: ### 2. Yang menentukan daya beli adalah selisih pendapatan dan harga
segments.tr: ### 2. What determines purchasing power is the difference between income and price

segments.src: Daya beli riil kira-kira setara dengan pertumbuhan pendapatan nominal dikurangi laju inflasi.
segments.tr: Real purchasing power is roughly equivalent to nominal income growth minus the inflation rate.

segments.src: Jika penghasilan seseorang tidak bergerak sepanjang tahun sementara harga naik 3 persen, kemampuan belanjanya tetap tergerus sekitar 3 persen.
segments.tr: If a person's income does not move throughout the year while prices rise 3 percent, their spending ability is still eroded by about 3 percent.

segments.src: Inflasi yang melandai hanya memperlambat erosi, tidak membalikkannya.
segments.tr: Flattening inflation only slows the erosion, it does not reverse it.

segments.src: ### 3. Inflasi rendah bisa datang dari sisi permintaan yang lemah
segments.tr: ### 3. Low inflation can come from weak demand

segments.src: Ada dua sumber inflasi rendah yang maknanya bertolak belakang.
segments.tr: There are two sources of low inflation with opposite meanings.

segments.src: **Pertama**, pasokan membaik sehingga harga turun — ini kabar baik.
segments.tr: **First**, supply improves so prices drop — this is good news.

segments.src: **Kedua**, masyarakat menahan belanja sehingga pedagang tidak berani menaikkan harga — ini justru sinyal pelemahan.
segments.tr: **Second**, people hold back spending so traders do not dare to raise prices — this is actually a signal of weakening.
How to tell them apart: look at **core inflation**.

segments.src: Komponen ini mengeluarkan pangan bergejolak dan harga yang diatur pemerintah, sehingga lebih mencerminkan tarikan permintaan.
segments.tr: This component excludes volatile food and government-regulated prices, so it better reflects the pull of demand.

segments.src: Bila inflasi utama melandai tetapi inflasi inti bertahan stabil, pelemahannya kemungkinan besar bersumber dari pasokan pangan.
segments.tr: If the main inflation flattens but core inflation remains stable, the weakening is likely sourced from food supply.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, bila inflasi inti ikut merosot tajam dan terus-menerus, itu perlu dibaca lebih hati-hati.
segments.tr: Conversely, if core inflation also plummets sharply and continuously, that needs to be read more carefully.

segments.src: ### 4. Deflasi pangan menekan sisi pendapatan produsen
segments.tr: ### 4. Food deflation presses the income side of producers

segments.src: Harga cabai yang jatuh terasa melegakan bagi pembeli di kota, tetapi merupakan pukulan bagi petani yang sudah menanggung biaya pupuk, bibit, dan tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: Falling chili prices feel relieving for buyers in the city, but are a blow to farmers who have already borne the costs of fertilizer, seeds, and labor.

segments.src: Ketika harga jual anjlok di bawah biaya produksi, pendapatan di wilayah perdesaan tertekan.
segments.tr: When the selling price plummets below the production cost, income in rural areas is pressured.

segments.src: Karena itu, rilis inflasi sebaiknya dibaca berdampingan dengan **Nilai Tukar Petani (NTP)** dan data upah riil buruh tani yang juga diterbitkan BPS.
segments.tr: Therefore, the inflation release should be read alongside the **Farmer's Terms of Trade (NTP)** and real wage data for farm laborers also published by BPS.

segments.src: Kedua indikator itu menunjukkan sisi lain dari cerita yang sama.
segments.tr: Those two indicators show the other side of the same story.

segments.src: ### 5. Keranjang belanja Anda berbeda dari keranjang statistik
segments.tr: ### 5. Your shopping basket is different from the statistical basket

segments.src: IHK disusun dari pola konsumsi rata-rata nasional.
segments.tr: The CPI is compiled from national average consumption patterns.

segments.src: Rumah tangga berpendapatan rendah membelanjakan porsi jauh lebih besar untuk makanan, transportasi, dan energi, sehingga **inflasi yang mereka rasakan bisa lebih tinggi** dari angka resmi.
segments.tr: Low-income households spend a much larger portion on food, transportation, and energy, so **the inflation they feel can be higher** than the official figure.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, rumah tangga yang porsi pengeluarannya lebih banyak pada jasa dan hiburan akan merasakan komposisi tekanan yang berbeda.
segments.tr: Conversely, households whose expenditure portion is more on services and entertainment will feel a different composition of pressure.

segments.src: Angka nasional bukan angka yang salah — ia hanya menjawab pertanyaan yang berbeda dari "berapa inflasi keluarga saya".
segments.tr: The national figure is not a wrong figure — it just answers a different question from "how much is my family's inflation".

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Rilis Hari Ini dalam Sepuluh Menit
segments.tr: ## How to Read Today's Release in Ten Minutes

segments.src: Bila Anda hanya punya waktu singkat, urutkan pembacaan seperti ini:
segments.tr: If you only have a short amount of time, order your reading like this:

segments.src: 1. **Catat angka utama** — inflasi bulanan dan tahunan, lalu bandingkan dengan sasaran inflasi yang berlaku, yakni kisaran 2,5 persen dengan toleransi satu persen ke atas dan ke bawah.
segments.tr: 1. **Note the main figures** — monthly and annual inflation, then compare them with the applicable inflation target, which is a range of 2.5 percent with a tolerance of one percent up and down.

segments.src: 2. **Langsung cari inflasi inti.** Ini indikator paling informatif tentang kekuatan permintaan domestik.
segments.tr: 2. **Immediately look for core inflation.** This is the most informative indicator of the strength of domestic demand.

segments.src: 3. **Periksa kelompok pangan bergejolak.** Apakah penurunan terkonsentrasi hanya pada cabai dan bawang, atau meluas ke beras, telur, dan daging?
segments.tr: 3. **Check the volatile food group.** Is the decrease concentrated only on chili and onions, or does it extend to rice, eggs, and meat?

segments.src: 4. **Lihat harga diatur pemerintah** (administered prices) — BBM, tarif listrik, angkutan, dan cukai. Komponen ini bergerak karena kebijakan, bukan mekanisme pasar.
segments.tr: 4. **Look at government-regulated prices** (administered prices) — fuel, electricity tariffs, transportation, and excise. This component moves due to policy, not market mechanisms.

segments.src: 5. **Baca komoditas penyumbang andil terbesar**, baik pendorong maupun penahan. Di sinilah cerita sesungguhnya berada.
segments.tr: 5. **Read the commodities contributing the largest share**, both drivers and restrainers. This is where the real story lies.

segments.src: 6. **Bandingkan dengan pengeluaran Anda sendiri.** Bila tiga pos terbesar dalam anggaran rumah tangga Anda tidak ikut turun, wajar jika penurunan angka nasional terasa tidak nyata.
segments.tr: 6. **Compare it with your own spending.** If the three largest items in your household budget do not also drop, it is natural if the national figure decrease feels unreal.
## What to Monitor After the Release

segments.src: Beberapa faktor akan menentukan arah harga pada sisa 2026:
segments.tr: Several factors will determine the direction of prices for the remainder of 2026:

segments.src: - **Peralihan musim dan risiko cuaca.** Berakhirnya masa panen kerap diikuti normalisasi — bahkan lonjakan — harga hortikultura. Penurunan Juli belum tentu berlanjut pada September hingga Desember.
segments.tr: - **Seasonal transitions and weather risks.** The end of the harvest period is often followed by normalization — or even surges — in horticultural prices. The July decrease may not continue into September to December.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar rupiah dan harga energi global.** Keduanya memengaruhi biaya barang impor, pakan ternak, dan ongkos logistik dengan jeda waktu beberapa bulan.
segments.tr: - **Rupiah exchange rate and global energy prices.** Both affect the cost of imported goods, animal feed, and logistics costs with a time lag of several months.

segments.src: - **Keputusan suku bunga Bank Indonesia.** Data inflasi merupakan salah satu masukan dalam Rapat Dewan Gubernur bulanan, di samping stabilitas nilai tukar dan kondisi likuiditas.
segments.tr: - **Bank Indonesia's interest rate decisions.** Inflation data is one of the inputs in the monthly Board of Governors Meeting, alongside exchange rate stability and liquidity conditions.

segments.src: - **Siklus permintaan akhir tahun.** Libur sekolah, hari besar keagamaan, dan periode Natal-Tahun Baru secara historis menambah tekanan pada transportasi dan pangan.
segments.tr: - **Year-end demand cycles.** School holidays, religious holidays, and the Christmas-New Year period historically add pressure to transportation and food.

segments.src: - **Indikator pendamping.** Indeks Keyakinan Konsumen, penjualan eceran, PMI manufaktur, serta pertumbuhan kredit konsumsi membantu memastikan apakah pelemahan harga berasal dari pasokan atau dari permintaan.
segments.tr: - **Supporting indicators.** Consumer Confidence Index, retail sales, manufacturing PMI, and consumer credit growth help ensure whether the price weakening comes from supply or demand.
## Practical Steps for Households

segments.src: Data makro baru bermanfaat bila bisa diterjemahkan ke keputusan sehari-hari.
segments.tr: Macro data is only useful if it can be translated into daily decisions.
Some things that can be done:

segments.src: - **Hitung "inflasi pribadi" Anda.** Catat total belanja bulanan selama tiga bulan dan bandingkan. Angka ini lebih relevan untuk perencanaan keluarga dibanding statistik nasional.
segments.tr: - **Calculate your "personal inflation".** Record total monthly spending for three months and compare. This figure is more relevant for family planning than national statistics.

segments.src: - **Manfaatkan jendela harga rendah dengan realistis.** Komoditas hortikultura sulit disimpan lama, sehingga pembelian berlebih justru berisiko terbuang. Bumbu yang dikeringkan atau dibekukan lebih masuk akal.
segments.tr: - **Utilize low-price windows realistically.** Horticultural commodities are difficult to store for long, so over-buying is actually risky as they may be wasted. Dried or frozen seasonings are more sensible.

segments.src: - **Prioritaskan pos yang bobotnya besar.** Efisiensi pada sewa, cicilan, transportasi, dan energi umumnya berdampak lebih besar dibanding berburu selisih harga kecil di pasar.
segments.tr: - **Prioritize items with large weights.** Efficiency in rent, installments, transportation, and energy generally has a larger impact than hunting for small price differences in the market.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan pengeluaran musiman.** Biaya pendidikan dan perjalanan akhir tahun kerap menjadi tekanan terbesar, jauh melampaui fluktuasi harga cabai.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to seasonal spending.** Education costs and year-end travel are often the biggest pressures, far exceeding chili price fluctuations.
## Conclusion

segments.src: Angka inflasi yang melandai adalah kabar yang menenangkan, tetapi bukan kesimpulan akhir tentang kesejahteraan.
segments.tr: A flattening inflation figure is calming news, but not the final conclusion about welfare.

segments.src: Inflasi rendah berarti harga naik lebih pelan — bukan berarti harga kembali murah, dan bukan pula bukti otomatis bahwa pendapatan masyarakat menguat.
segments.tr: Low inflation means prices are rising more slowly — it doesn't mean prices have returned to being cheap, nor is it automatic evidence that public income is strengthening.

segments.src: Yang layak dicermati dari rilis hari ini bukan hanya headline-nya, melainkan komposisinya: seberapa kuat inflasi inti bertahan, seberapa luas penurunan harga pangan, dan bagaimana kondisi pendapatan di sisi produsen.
segments.tr: What is worth noting from today's release is not just the headline, but its composition: how strong core inflation remains, how widespread the food price decrease is, and how income conditions are on the producer side.

segments.src: Tiga hal itu, bukan angka tunggal, yang menjawab pertanyaan apakah daya beli benar-benar ikut membaik.
segments.tr: Those three things, not a single figure, answer the question of whether purchasing power is truly improving.
### Editorial Note

segments.src: Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi dan edukasi umum.
segments.tr: This article was compiled for general information and educational purposes.

segments.src: Angka 3,08 persen yang disebutkan merupakan perkiraan konsensus ekonom menjelang rilis, **bukan data resmi**.
segments.tr: The 3.08 percent figure mentioned is a consensus estimate of economists ahead of the release, **not official data**.

segments.src: Untuk angka final dan rinciannya, silakan merujuk langsung pada publikasi resmi Badan Pusat Statistik melalui situs bps.go.id, serta rilis Bank Indonesia untuk konteks kebijakan moneter.
segments.tr: For final figures and details, please refer directly to the official publications of the Central Bureau of Statistics via the bps.go.id website, as well as Bank Indonesia releases for monetary policy context.

segments.src: Isi tulisan ini bukan merupakan rekomendasi investasi, saran keuangan, maupun ajakan untuk melakukan transaksi tertentu.
segments.tr: The content of this writing is not an investment recommendation, financial advice, or an invitation to perform specific transactions.

segments.src: Setiap keputusan finansial sepenuhnya menjadi tanggung jawab pembaca dan sebaiknya dipertimbangkan sesuai kondisi masing-masing.
segments.tr: Every financial decision is entirely the responsibility of the reader and should be considered according to their respective conditions.

id-20260803-news-2.title: 30 Kg Rice Aid Disbursed Starting August 17 for 33.24 Million Families: Here is How Recipients are Determined

segments.src: Pemerintah kembali menggulirkan bantuan pangan berupa beras untuk masyarakat berpenghasilan rendah.
segments.tr: The government is once again rolling out food assistance in the form of rice for low-income communities.

segments.src: Badan Pangan Nasional (Bapanas) menugaskan Perum Bulog menyalurkan total **997.200 ton beras** kepada **33,24 juta keluarga penerima manfaat (KPM)**, dengan penyaluran dijadwalkan mulai **17 Agustus 2026**.
segments.tr: The National Food Agency (Bapanas) has assigned Perum Bulog to distribute a total of **997,200 tons of rice** to **33.24 million beneficiary families (KPM)**, with distribution scheduled to begin on **August 17, 2026**.

segments.src: Skemanya: masing-masing keluarga menerima **10 kilogram per bulan** untuk alokasi **Juli, Agustus, dan September**.
segments.tr: The scheme: each family receives **10 kilograms per month** for the **July, August, and September** allocations.

segments.src: Karena alokasi Juli dirapel, banyak penerima akan menerima **30 kilogram sekaligus** pada penyaluran tahap ini — angka yang kemudian ramai dibicarakan di media sosial.
segments.tr: Because the July allocation is backpaid, many recipients will receive **30 kilograms at once** during this distribution phase — a figure that has since become a hot topic on social media.

segments.src: Namun pertanyaan yang paling banyak muncul bukan soal jumlahnya, melainkan: **siapa yang masuk daftar, dan siapa yang berpotensi tersisih?** Jawabannya ada pada satu hal — basis data yang dipakai.
segments.tr: However, the most common question is not about the amount, but rather: **who is on the list, and who is potentially left out?** The answer lies in one thing — the database used.
## Quick Summary
| Aspect | Description |
| Form of aid | Medium rice |

segments.src: | Jumlah per keluarga | 10 kg per bulan |
segments.tr: | Amount per family | 10 kg per month |
| Allocation | July, August, September |

segments.src: | Total potensi diterima | Hingga 30 kg (jika dirapel) |
segments.tr: | Total potential received | Up to 30 kg (if backpaid) |
| Number of recipients | 33.24 million KPM |
| Total rice distributed | 997,200 tons |
| Distribution start date | August 17, 2026 |
| Implementer | Perum Bulog, assigned by Bapanas |

segments.src: | Basis data penerima | Data Tunggal Sosial dan Ekonomi Nasional (DTSEN) versi ketiga |
segments.tr: | Recipient database | National Social and Economic Single Data (DTSEN) version three |
| Cost | Free, no charges |
## Why the Database is Key

segments.src: Sejak pemerintah mendorong integrasi data penerima bantuan sosial, penetapan penerima tidak lagi mengacu pada satu daftar yang berdiri sendiri di tiap kementerian.
segments.tr: Since the government has pushed for the integration of social assistance recipient data, the determination of recipients is no longer based on a standalone list in each ministry.

segments.src: Semuanya diarahkan ke **Data Tunggal Sosial dan Ekonomi Nasional (DTSEN)** — basis data terpadu yang menggabungkan berbagai sumber data kependudukan dan sosial ekonomi.
segments.tr: Everything is directed to the **National Social and Economic Single Data (DTSEN)** — an integrated database that combines various population and socio-economic data sources.

segments.src: Untuk penyaluran kali ini, acuannya adalah **DTSEN versi ketiga**.
segments.tr: For this distribution, the reference is **DTSEN version three**.

segments.src: Artinya, daftar penerima yang berlaku bukan daftar tahun lalu, bukan pula daftar versi sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This means the applicable recipient list is not last year's list, nor is it a previous version.

segments.src: Ada pemutakhiran, dan pemutakhiran itu punya dua sisi:
segments.tr: There have been updates, and those updates have two sides:

segments.src: - **Sisi positif:** keluarga yang kondisinya memburuk dan sebelumnya belum terdata berpeluang masuk.
segments.tr: - **Positive side:** families whose conditions have worsened and were previously unrecorded have a chance to be included.

segments.src: - **Sisi yang perlu diwaspadai:** keluarga yang sebelumnya menerima bisa saja tidak lagi tercatat, entah karena perubahan status ekonomi, perpindahan domisili, data kependudukan yang tidak sinkron, atau hasil verifikasi lapangan.
segments.tr: - **Side to be cautious of:** families who previously received aid may no longer be listed, whether due to changes in economic status, change of residence, unsynchronized population data, or field verification results.

segments.src: Inilah alasan sebagian orang yang tahun lalu menerima bantuan mendapati namanya tidak muncul tahun ini — dan sebaliknya, ada yang baru pertama kali masuk daftar.
segments.tr: This is why some people who received aid last year find their names missing this year — and conversely, some are on the list for the first time.
## How the Recipient List is Compiled

segments.src: Secara umum, alur penetapan penerima bantuan pangan berjalan melalui beberapa tahap berikut.
segments.tr: Generally, the process of determining food aid recipients follows these stages.
Data collection and merging**

segments.src: DTSEN dibangun dari kombinasi data kependudukan, data sosial ekonomi hasil pendataan lapangan, serta data dari program-program bantuan yang sudah berjalan.
segments.tr: DTSEN is built from a combination of population data, socio-economic data from field surveys, and data from existing assistance programs.

segments.src: Tujuannya menghilangkan duplikasi dan tumpang tindih antarprogram.
segments.tr: The goal is to eliminate duplication and overlap between programs.
Welfare ranking**

segments.src: Rumah tangga dikelompokkan berdasarkan tingkat kesejahteraan.
segments.tr: Households are grouped based on their level of welfare.

segments.src: Program bantuan pangan umumnya menyasar kelompok dengan tingkat kesejahteraan terendah, sesuai kuota yang ditetapkan.
segments.tr: Food assistance programs generally target groups with the lowest welfare levels, according to the set quota.
Regional proposals and verification**

segments.src: Pemerintah desa/kelurahan dan dinas sosial daerah punya peran dalam mengusulkan penambahan (bagi yang layak tapi belum terdata) maupun mengusulkan pencoretan (bagi yang sudah tidak layak).
segments.tr: Village/neighborhood governments and regional social services play a role in proposing additions (for those eligible but not yet recorded) or proposing removals (for those no longer eligible).

segments.src: Mekanisme ini biasa disebut usulan dan sanggahan.
segments.tr: This mechanism is commonly referred to as proposals and objections.
Determination and distribution**

segments.src: Setelah daftar ditetapkan, Bulog menyalurkan beras ke titik-titik distribusi.
segments.tr: Once the list is finalized, Bulog distributes the rice to distribution points.

segments.src: Penerima mengambil bantuan dengan membawa identitas diri sesuai data.
segments.tr: Recipients collect the aid by bringing identification according to the data.

segments.src: Yang perlu dipahami: **tidak ada mekanisme mendaftar mandiri secara online untuk langsung menjadi penerima bantuan beras ini.** Jalur resmi untuk masuk daftar adalah melalui pendataan dan usulan di tingkat desa/kelurahan.
segments.tr: What needs to be understood: **there is no mechanism for independent online registration to immediately become a recipient of this rice aid.** The official channel to get on the list is through data collection and proposals at the village/neighborhood level.
## How to Check Recipient Status

segments.src: Bagi yang ingin memastikan apakah namanya termasuk penerima, ada beberapa jalur yang bisa ditempuh:
segments.tr: For those who want to ensure whether their name is included as a recipient, there are several paths that can be taken:
**Through the village or neighborhood office**
This is the most direct path.

segments.src: Daftar penerima biasanya tersedia di kantor desa/kelurahan dan bisa ditanyakan ke perangkat setempat.
segments.tr: The recipient list is usually available at the village/neighborhood office and can be asked of local officials.

segments.src: Bawa Kartu Keluarga dan KTP untuk mempermudah pengecekan.
segments.tr: Bring your Family Card and ID card to facilitate the check.
**Through official Ministry of Social Affairs channels**

segments.src: Kementerian Sosial menyediakan laman pengecekan status penerima bantuan sosial.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Social Affairs provides a page to check the status of social assistance recipients.

segments.src: Pengecekan umumnya memerlukan data wilayah (provinsi, kabupaten/kota, kecamatan, desa/kelurahan) dan nama sesuai KTP.
segments.tr: Checking generally requires regional data (province, regency/city, district, village/neighborhood) and a name as per the ID card.
**Through local RT/RW (neighborhood heads)**

segments.src: Untuk informasi jadwal dan titik pengambilan, pengurus RT/RW biasanya menjadi sumber informasi pertama yang paling cepat diperbarui.
segments.tr: For information on schedules and collection points, RT/RW heads are usually the first and fastest source of updated information.

segments.src: > **Catatan penting:** Alamat situs dan aplikasi resmi dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu. Pastikan Anda mengakses kanal yang benar-benar resmi — biasanya berdomain **go.id** — dan hindari tautan dari pesan berantai.
segments.tr: > **Important note:** Official website addresses and applications may change at any time. Ensure you access truly official channels — usually with a **go.id** domain — and avoid links from chain messages.

segments.src: ## Kalau Merasa Layak tapi Tidak Masuk Daftar
segments.tr: ## If You Feel Eligible but Are Not on the List

segments.src: Tidak masuk daftar bukan berarti tidak ada jalan.
segments.tr: Not being on the list does not mean there is no way.
Steps that can be taken:

segments.src: 1. **Datangi kantor desa/kelurahan** dan tanyakan status data keluarga Anda di DTSEN.
segments.tr: 1. **Visit the village/neighborhood office** and ask about your family's data status in DTSEN.

segments.src: 2. **Ajukan usulan pemutakhiran data** melalui musyawarah desa/kelurahan. Ini adalah mekanisme resmi untuk mengusulkan penambahan penerima.
segments.tr: 2. **Submit a proposal for data update** through village/neighborhood meetings. This is the official mechanism to propose adding recipients.

segments.src: 3. **Pastikan data kependudukan sinkron.** Banyak kasus gagal terdata bersumber dari hal administratif: NIK tidak padan, alamat KTP berbeda dengan domisili, atau Kartu Keluarga belum diperbarui setelah pindah, menikah, atau ada anggota keluarga meninggal.
segments.tr: 3. **Ensure population data is synchronized.** Many cases of failure to be recorded stem from administrative issues: NIK (National ID Number) not matching, ID card address different from actual residence, or Family Card not updated after moving, marrying, or having a family member pass away.

segments.src: 4. **Simpan bukti pengajuan.** Catat tanggal dan nama petugas yang menerima pengajuan Anda.
segments.tr: 4. **Keep proof of submission.** Note the date and the name of the officer who received your proposal.

segments.src: Perlu dipahami juga bahwa daftar penerima terikat kuota.
segments.tr: It should also be understood that the recipient list is bound by a quota.

segments.src: Meski sebuah keluarga dinilai layak, penambahan tetap bergantung pada kuota dan hasil verifikasi.
segments.tr: Even if a family is deemed eligible, additions still depend on the quota and verification results.
## Beware of Fraud Modus

segments.src: Setiap kali program bantuan digulirkan, penipuan berkedok bantuan ikut naik.
segments.tr: Every time an assistance program is rolled out, fraud disguised as aid also increases.
Some recurring patterns:

segments.src: - **Permintaan biaya administrasi.** Bantuan pangan ini **gratis**. Tidak ada pungutan dalam bentuk apa pun, termasuk "uang transport", "biaya cetak kartu", atau "uang rokok petugas".
segments.tr: - **Requests for administration fees.** This food aid is **free**. There are no charges of any kind, including "transportation money", "card printing fees", or "tips for officers".

segments.src: - **Tautan pendaftaran palsu.** Beredar tautan yang mengaku sebagai formulir pendaftaran penerima. Karena penetapan penerima berbasis DTSEN, formulir semacam ini patut dicurigai.
segments.tr: - **Fake registration links.** Links claiming to be recipient registration forms are circulating. Since recipient determination is based on DTSEN, such forms should be suspected.

segments.src: - **Permintaan data sensitif.** Kode OTP, PIN, dan password mobile banking tidak pernah diminta petugas mana pun.
segments.tr: - **Requests for sensitive data.** OTP codes, PINs, and mobile banking passwords are never requested by any officer.

segments.src: - **Aplikasi di luar toko resmi.** Berkas aplikasi yang dikirim lewat pesan pribadi berisiko tinggi. Unduh aplikasi hanya dari toko aplikasi resmi.
segments.tr: - **Applications outside official stores.** Application files sent via private messages are high risk. Download applications only from official app stores.

segments.src: - **Mengatasnamakan pejabat.** Klaim "bisa memasukkan nama Anda ke daftar" dengan imbalan tertentu adalah tanda bahaya.
segments.tr: - **Impersonating officials.** Claims that they "can put your name on the list" in exchange for something are a red flag.

segments.src: Jika ragu, konfirmasi langsung ke kantor desa/kelurahan atau dinas sosial setempat.
segments.tr: If in doubt, confirm directly with the village/neighborhood office or local social services.

segments.src: ## Konteks Ekonomi di Balik Program Ini
segments.tr: ## Economic Context Behind This Program

segments.src: Bantuan pangan beras bukan sekadar program karitatif.
segments.tr: Rice food aid is not just a charitable program.

segments.src: Ia punya fungsi ganda dalam pengelolaan ekonomi:
segments.tr: It has a dual function in economic management:

segments.src: **Menjaga daya beli rumah tangga bawah.** Beras menyerap porsi besar dari pengeluaran rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah.
segments.tr: **Maintaining the purchasing power of lower-income households.** Rice accounts for a large portion of the spending of low-income households.

segments.src: Ketika harga pangan naik, kelompok inilah yang paling cepat terdampak.
segments.tr: When food prices rise, this group is the most quickly affected.

segments.src: Bantuan berbentuk barang membantu menahan tekanan tersebut secara langsung.
segments.tr: Aid in the form of goods helps to directly withstand that pressure.

segments.src: **Meredam tekanan harga.** Penyaluran beras dalam volume besar dari cadangan pemerintah dapat mengurangi permintaan di pasar dari kelompok penerima, yang pada gilirannya membantu menstabilkan harga.
segments.tr: **Damping price pressure.** The distribution of rice in large volumes from government reserves can reduce market demand from the recipient group, which in turn helps stabilize prices.

segments.src: **Mengelola stok cadangan.** Cadangan Beras Pemerintah perlu dirotasi agar kualitasnya terjaga.
segments.tr: **Managing reserve stocks.** Government Rice Reserves need to be rotated to maintain quality.

segments.src: Program penyaluran menjadi salah satu instrumen rotasi tersebut.
segments.tr: The distribution program serves as one of the rotation instruments.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, program berskala besar seperti ini selalu menghadapi tantangan klasik: **akurasi data**.
segments.tr: On the other hand, large-scale programs like this always face a classic challenge: **data accuracy**.

segments.src: Dua jenis kesalahan yang selalu jadi perhatian adalah *inclusion error* (yang tidak layak ikut menerima) dan *exclusion error* (yang layak justru tidak menerima).
segments.tr: Two types of errors that are always a concern are *inclusion error* (those not eligible who receive aid) and *exclusion error* (those eligible who do not receive aid).

segments.src: Penyempurnaan DTSEN ke versi ketiga adalah upaya menekan keduanya — meski proses semacam ini secara realistis membutuhkan waktu dan perbaikan berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: The refinement of DTSEN to version three is an effort to reduce both — although such a process realistically requires time and continuous improvement.
## Things Recipients Should Note

segments.src: Bagi yang namanya sudah masuk daftar, beberapa hal praktis:
segments.tr: For those whose names are already on the list, some practical tips:

segments.src: - **Pantau jadwal penyaluran di wilayah masing-masing.** Tanggal 17 Agustus 2026 adalah awal penyaluran secara nasional, bukan berarti seluruh daerah menerima serempak di hari yang sama. Jadwal tiap wilayah bisa berbeda menyesuaikan distribusi.
segments.tr: - **Monitor the distribution schedule in your respective area.** August 17, 2026, is the start of national distribution, not meaning all regions receive it simultaneously on the same day. Schedules for each region may vary depending on distribution.

segments.src: - **Siapkan identitas.** KTP dan Kartu Keluarga umumnya diperlukan saat pengambilan.
segments.tr: - **Prepare identification.** ID card and Family Card are generally required during collection.

segments.src: - **Periksa kondisi beras saat diterima.** Jika ditemukan beras dengan kualitas tidak layak, laporkan ke petugas penyalur atau perangkat desa. Ada mekanisme penggantian untuk kasus semacam ini.
segments.tr: - **Check the condition of the rice upon receipt.** If rice of unacceptable quality is found, report it to the distribution officer or village officials. There is a replacement mechanism for such cases.

segments.src: - **Jangan menandatangani tanda terima sebelum menerima barang.**
segments.tr: - **Do not sign the receipt before receiving the goods.**

segments.src: - **Laporkan jika ada pemotongan.** Bantuan harus diterima utuh sesuai ketentuan.
segments.tr: - **Report if there are any deductions.** Aid must be received in full according to the regulations.
## Closing

segments.src: Penyaluran beras 10 kilogram per bulan untuk alokasi Juli–September kepada 33,24 juta keluarga adalah salah satu program bantuan pangan berskala besar tahun ini.
segments.tr: The distribution of 10 kilograms of rice per month for the July–September allocation to 33.24 million families is one of the large-scale food assistance programs this year.

segments.src: Namun bagian yang paling menentukan bagi tiap keluarga bukanlah angka nasionalnya, melainkan satu pertanyaan sederhana: apakah data keluarga Anda tercatat dengan benar di DTSEN.
segments.tr: However, the most decisive part for each family is not the national figure, but one simple question: is your family's data correctly recorded in DTSEN.

segments.src: Karena itu, langkah paling berguna yang bisa dilakukan sekarang bukan menunggu, melainkan **memeriksa status data ke kantor desa atau kelurahan**.
segments.tr: Therefore, the most useful step that can be taken now is not to wait, but to **check your data status at the village or neighborhood office**.

segments.src: Jika ada yang tidak sesuai, ajukan pemutakhiran melalui jalur resmi.
segments.tr: If anything is incorrect, submit a request for update through official channels.

segments.src: Data yang akurat adalah pintu masuk ke hampir seluruh program bantuan pemerintah, bukan hanya yang satu ini.
segments.tr: Accurate data is the gateway to almost all government assistance programs, not just this one.

segments.tr: *This article was compiled as general information based on information circulating in the public space.

segments.src: Ketentuan teknis, jadwal, dan daftar penerima dapat berubah.
segments.tr: Technical terms, schedules, and recipient lists may change.

segments.src: Untuk kepastian, rujuk pengumuman resmi Badan Pangan Nasional, Kementerian Sosial, Perum Bulog, atau pemerintah daerah setempat.*
segments.tr: For certainty, refer to official announcements from the National Food Agency, Ministry of Social Affairs, Perum Bulog, or local regional governments.*
